chunks: When Moses said to his people: "O my people, why do you afflict me though you know that I have been sent to you by God?" But when they turned aside God made their hearts turn farther away; for God does not show the transgressors the way.
ai.seo_question: Why did God cause the hearts of Moses' people to turn away after they knew he was His messenger?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'azagh Allahu qulabahum' (God caused their hearts to stray) is often interpreted as a divine sealing of the heart due to their voluntary initial deviation, illustrating the principle of 'tawabi al-af'al' (consequence of actions). This verse underscores the transition from mere disbelief to a state of spiritual hardness, where God actively reinforces their choice to remain among the 'fasiqin' (transgressors). It serves as a cautionary example of how persistent rejection of clear truth leads to a loss of divine guidance.
